scenario_name: Dudhsagar Falls trek route closure (flash-flood warning)

trigger.reason: Forest department closes the jeep-safari trek route 09:00-13:00 after overnight heavy rain triggers a flash-flood warning (common June-Sept monsoon risk)

original_plan_for_window.quality_note: Arrival at 11:00 lands mid-closure (route reopens 13:00) — the whole booked visit is at risk of a wasted trip

recovery_plans.label: Reorder: spice farm first, shortened falls visit after reopening
recovery_plans.description: Head to the nearby Sahakari Spice Farm for the morning instead, then travel on to Dudhsagar right after the 13:00 reopening for a shortened visit before the 17:00 close.

steps.name: North Goa to Sahakari Spice Farm
Spice Farm to Dudhsagar Falls (route via Ponda)

recovery_plans.tradeoff: Same total time as the original booking, but costs 1200 more rupees (a second transport leg since you go out-and-back) for a spice farm add-on plus only 35 min at the falls instead of 240.
recovery_plans.best_for: Travelers who refuse to miss Dudhsagar entirely and can absorb the extra transport cost

recovery_plans.label: Substitute: skip Dudhsagar, do Old Goa churches instead
recovery_plans.description: Drop Dudhsagar from today's plan entirely. Visit the Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral in Old Goa, then browse Anjuna's laid-back stalls — no closure risk, much shorter commitment.

steps.name: North Goa to Old Goa Churches

recovery_plans.tradeoff: Saves 1900 rupees and frees up over 2 hours of buffer/rest time. Dudhsagar is deferred, not lost — best attempted on a later day when there's no active flood warning.
recovery_plans.best_for: Budget-conscious travelers, or anyone uneasy about monsoon trek conditions

recovery_plans.label: Pivot: relaxed beach day, then Baga nightlife with dinner folded in
recovery_plans.description: Skip the day-long waterfall trip altogether. Spend the freed-up day at Baga Beach, then head into the evening with dinner at a beach shack followed by Tito's Lane, replacing a separately-planned dinner stop.

baseline_for_comparison.note: Compare against original window (2400) plus a separate dinner you'd have paid anyway (~700 at Britto's)

recovery_plans.tradeoff: Costs 1400 less than the original waterfall day plus a normal dinner, since the day-long Dudhsagar booking and transport are dropped entirely in favor of beach time and a low-key nightlife evening with dinner folded in.
recovery_plans.best_for: Travelers who'd rather not gamble on a monsoon-closure reopening and enjoy Goa's nightlife instead
